300+ million people in emerging markets lack access to credit or stable yield. Crypto holders face a similar challenge — forced to liquidate assets just to access cash.

HODL is the solution: a protocol for instant, secure, local money movement.

Why Choose HODL?

Benefits designed to provide a seamless, secure, and accessible experience for all users.

Local First

Dual Access

Fast & Flexible

Redefining the future of investing solutions

Harness cutting-edge technology built to the highest industry standard, setting a new benchmark for modern investing.

Unlock Liquidity Without Selling

For crypto holders: Deposit ETH, USDT or other tokens as collateral and access instant Naira liquidity — no selling, no stress.

Earn in Your Currency

For everyday savers: Deposit local fiat or stables and earn real yield — without needing to trade, stake, or understand DeFi.

Compliant, Transparent, and Onchain

Smart contracts power everything. KYC where it matters. Withdraw anytime. Full control, zero surprises.

Built for Local Markets

From off-ramp support to fiat-first design — every part of HODL is built for the way people use money in emerging markets.

Two Paths. One Simple App.

With HODL, you can earn daily yield or unlock instant liquidity in just a few steps. Fast, clear, and secure — everything happens in one wallet.

Start Earning in 3 Steps

1

Step 1: Fund your vault.

Deposit Fiat from your bank or crypto from your wallet.

2

Step 2: We grow your money.

Funds are routed to on-chain borrowers and high-yield credit instruments.

3

Step 3: Watch your earnings grow.

Track daily yield and withdraw anytime
